title: Pasting normalized exact and right-derived units across an exchange
statement: Let C,U,Y,X,Z,B be abelian categories with derived categories and K-injective resolutions in U,X,Z. Let J:C→U, R:U→Y, I:Y→Z, O:U→X, P:X→Z, S:Z→B, H:C→X, W:X→B, F:C→Y and G:Y→B be additive functors. Assume J,I,O,H,F,G are exact and P preserves K-injective complexes. Give ordinary maps ah:F→J⋙R, ae:G→I⋙S, χ:R⋙I→O⋙P, and a derived exchange Γ:R(R)⋙D(I)→D(O)⋙R(P). Assume on every homotopy object K of U that D(I)(u_R(K)) followed by Γ(QK) and R(P)(f_O(K)) equals f_I(RK) followed by Q(χ̄_K) and u_P(OK); here f denotes exact-derived homotopy factors and χ̄ includes the canonical homotopy composition factors. Give isomorphisms eo:H≅J⋙O and ep:P⋙S≅W. For an ordinary map a:F→J⋙R, write η(a):D(F)→D(J)⋙R(R) for the descent of f_F, then Q(a) with inverse homotopy composition factor, then u_R on J, then R(R) applied to the inverse f_J. Then η(ah) whiskered by D(G), followed by η(ae) whiskered by D(J)⋙R(R), followed by Γ whiskered by D(J) and R(S), followed by right-derived composition for ep, and finally inverse exact-derived triangle for eo whiskered by R(W), equals inverse exact-derived composition for F,G followed by η(t). The ordinary map t is ah whiskered by G, followed by ae whiskered by J and R, then χ whiskered by J and S, then ep whiskered by J⋙O, then eo inverse whiskered by W. Conventions: [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-asd-compact-support-graph-comparison].

proof.text: Precompose by the fully faithful homotopy localization. Expand both normalized units and use naturality to move the ordinary input maps and the exact-derived comparison factors.

Apply the assumed mixed exchange unit identity. Use naturality of the second right-derived unit and its composition unit formula. Cancel the open-composition factors using the exact-derived triangle factorization.

The remaining equality is an ordinary homotopy-category composite. Choose a complex representative and check it degree by degree using naturality of the second input map and cancellation of the open-composition isomorphism. Descend by full faithfulness.

theorem normalizedDerivedUnitPasting
    {C U Y X Z B : Type*}
  [Category C] [Category U] [Category Y] [Category X] [Category Z] [Category B]
  [Abelian C] [Abelian U] [Abelian Y] [Abelian X] [Abelian Z] [Abelian B]
  [HasDerivedCategory C] [HasDerivedCategory U] [HasDerivedCategory Y]
  [HasDerivedCategory X] [HasDerivedCategory Z] [HasDerivedCategory B]
  [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions U] [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions X]
  [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions Z]
  (J : C ⥤ U) (R : U ⥤ Y) (I : Y ⥤ Z) (O : U ⥤ X)
  (P : X ⥤ Z) (S : Z ⥤ B) (H : C ⥤ X) (W : X ⥤ B)
  (F : C ⥤ Y) (G : Y ⥤ B)
  [J.Additive] [R.Additive] [I.Additive] [O.Additive] [P.Additive] [S.Additive]
  [H.Additive] [W.Additive] [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
  [PreservesFiniteLimits J] [PreservesFiniteColimits J]
  [PreservesFiniteLimits I] [PreservesFiniteColimits I]
  [PreservesFiniteLimits O] [PreservesFiniteColimits O]
  [PreservesFiniteLimits H] [PreservesFiniteColimits H]
  [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
  [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
  [P.PreservesKInjectiveComplexes]
    (ah : F ⟶ J ⋙ R) (ae : G ⟶ I ⋙ S)
    (χ : R ⋙ I ⟶ O ⋙ P)
    (Γ : R.rightDerivedFunctor ⋙ I.mapDerivedCategory ⟶
      O.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ P.rightDerivedFunctor)
    (hn : ∀ K : HomotopyCategory U (.up ℤ),
      I.mapDerivedCategory.map (R.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K) ≫
          Γ.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) ≫
          P.rightDerivedFunctor.map (O.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app K) =
        I.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app ((R.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Qh.map
            ((Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso (Iso.refl (R ⋙ I)) (.up ℤ)).hom.app K ≫
              (χ.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).app K ≫
              (Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso (Iso.refl (O ⋙ P)) (.up ℤ)).inv.app K) ≫
          P.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app ((O.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj K))
    (eo : H ≅ J ⋙ O) (ep : P ⋙ S ≅ W) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (normalizationLocalizationDesc DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso C (.up ℤ))
          (normalizationHomotopyTransformation F J R ah)) G.mapDerivedCategory ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (J.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ R.rightDerivedFunctor)
          (normalizationLocalizationDesc DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso Y (.up ℤ))
          (normalizationHomotopyTransformation G I S ae)) ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft J.mapDerivedCategory (Functor.whiskerRight Γ S.rightDerivedFunctor) ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (J.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ O.mapDerivedCategory)
          (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompIso' P S ep).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryTriangleIso eo).inv
          W.rightDerivedFunctor =
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso F G).inv ≫
        (fun a₀ ↦ normalizationLocalizationDesc DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso C (.up ℤ))
          (normalizationHomotopyTransformation (F ⋙ G) H W a₀))
          (Functor.whiskerRight ah G ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft J (Functor.whiskerLeft R ae) ≫
            Functor.whiskerLeft J (Functor.whiskerRight χ S) ≫
            Functor.whiskerLeft (J ⋙ O) ep.hom ≫ Functor.whiskerRight eo.inv W)
